what.text: This page follows asylum seekers from Ireland in all host countries: people who have asked for international protection and are waiting for a decision.
At the end of 2025, UNHCR counted 330 Irish asylum seekers, and Canada hosted 46.1% of them.
After Canada, the largest hosts are Australia, the United States and New Zealand.

why.text: The fact pack records no armed conflict and no dated events for Ireland, so it does not say why people left.
The main years of displacement in the data are 2023 to 2025.

when.text: UNHCR's series starts in 2003 at 10 asylum seekers.
The figure was at its highest, 405, at the end of 2024, and was lower at the end of 2025.

how.text: The sources don't say which routes people took.
These are year-end totals summed over every host country that reported to UNHCR.
